messages:
Mira S.: quick q — can we scope a model alias fallback only to a route + header? need it for ingest pipeline where we can accept lower-quality but cheaper models
Alex T.: yeah, route-level fallback scope exists but we've avoided adding per-route pin exceptions. what's the exact rule you want?
Mira S.: proposal:
```yaml
route: /api/ingest
match: header X-Model-Tier == "best-effort"
primary_alias: gptx-ops
fallback_aliases: [gptx-lite]
pin: version=2026-03-10 # pin primary for safety
allow_fallback_when_cached: true
```
Sam K.: ok but quota implications: if fallback triggers we still charge at primary's rate? we'd rather meter on the actually-served model
Riyad P.: we currently charge by selected model at runtime. but routing happens in gateway — need to ensure billing call happens after final selection
Alex T.: agree. we should emit telemetry events: `model.routing.final_selected` and `model.routing.fallback_reason` (include route + header)
Mira S.: console UX request: show a per-route "compatibility override" badge with hover explaining header rule and last 24h fallback rate
Sam K.: also add a toggle for "allow fallback under quota shortage" — for Dedicated customers only, default false
deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing/gateway: add per-route fallback condition handlers — PR #4567
Riyad P.: implementation notes: do NOT change default pin semantics. add explicit `route.rule.allow_fallback = true`. fallback MUST be logged with keys: route, tenant, primary_alias, selected_alias, reason, latency_ms, quota_state
Mira S.: for telemetry schema: event `model.route.fallback` with attrs [route, tenant_id, primary, fallback, header_match, reason, timestamp] — helps console charts
Sam K.: billing hook: ensure meter uses `selected_alias` tag; if fallback triggered because of quota, attach `fallback_reason=quota_shortage` so billing/backfill can be reconciled
Alex T.: on the console page: add small sparkline for fallback rate and a button to view last 100 fallback traces. also add a rollout control: canary percent for route-level fallback (0/5/10/25/50/100)
Mira S.: good. one more ask — telemetry should include whether KV-cache saved the latency difference (so we can see cost savings when fallback hits cache)
Riyad P.: noted. we'll append `cache_hit=true/false` to the fallback event.
Sam K.: picking up billing hook + event schema. will open PR today.
Alex T.: i'll do console badge + viz + rollout control.
Mira S.: thanks team :tada:
